text:
maria_ae: Heads-up: FinServ POC on Friday 10:00-16:00 PST. Customer wants a live stress demo with minimal tail latency. Can we get an ephemeral dedicated pool pre-warmed? target ~6 GPUs steady, short bursts to 12 for ~4 hours.
noah_se: Need clarity on billing mode: soft escrow vs short-term commit. Also require scoped API key and IP allowlist.
tess_infra: We can do ephemeral pool `fin-poc-warm`. Soft-escrow would reserve credits and cap usage; hard commit will be billed to the customer account. Which do you want?
maria_ae: Prefer soft-escrow to avoid upfront commit. Will approve escrow up to $1.5k. Must guarantee no cold-starts during demo.
kai_runtime: We can prewarm workers and warm KV cache. Need model + max seq and expected peak qps to tune prewarm. Also add `prewarm=true` flag to job.
\maria_ae: Model: `redwood-13b-v1-q4`. Seq length 512. Peak target 80 qps, bursts to 140.
kai_runtime: Recommended autoscale policy snippet: 
```
{"min_gpus":"6","max_gpus":"12","scale_up_qps":"70","cooldown_s":"90","burst_bucket":"fin-demo-credits","prewarm":"true","drain_s":"300"}
```
tess_infra: We'll provision pool with those settings and run a prewarm job 45m before start. Need customer CIDRs for IP ACL.
amber_csm: FinServ requested KMS key restriction to pool service account and audit logs retained for 90 days. For POC they accepted hosted dedicated + IP allowlist.
maria_ae: Sending CIDRs in DM. Also request a scoped read-only AE key and short-lived demo key for the customer.
tess_infra: Creating scoped key `fin-demo-ae` valid 10h and `fin-demo-cust` valid 6h. Keys stored in vault and shared via secure channel.
noah_se: If escrow depletes mid-demo, what's the behavior? fallback to smaller model or throttle?
tess_infra: Soft-escrow caps usage. On depletion we can auto-fallback to `redwood-7b-v2-q4` and apply throttling. We will not auto-bill past escrow without explicit approval.
maria_ae: Approve fallback to 7b and throttling. Add conversion path to runbook in case they want to convert to hard-reserve mid-demo.
kai_runtime: Noted. We'll add route-based fallback and prewarm synthetic smoke test 2h before and a short smoke 30m before. Console traces will be posted to the thread.
deploy-bot: pool `fin-poc-warm` scheduled for provisioning by infra at 2025-11-07T17:00:00Z. Will update status here. :white_check_mark:
noah_se: Great. Please include the autoscale snippet and escrow amount in the customer email.
\mamria_ae: Typo above; will send update now. Thanks team.
